user_query: How did the authors construct the co-author network used for visualization, and what were the final network size and edge count after filtering authors with low degree?
llm_response: The authors built the co-author network by taking the publication records in their dataset, treating each author as a node, and adding an edge between two authors whenever they had coauthored at least one paper. They then filtered out low-degree authors to simplify the visualization. After this filtering step, the final network contained 1,024 authors (nodes) and 3,842 co-author links (edges).
